paper_title: Axion-like Relics: New Constraints from Old Comagnetometer Data
coupling_convention: g_aNN in GeV^-1 (as plotted, labeled g_aNN [GeV^-1])
notes: Paper constrains ALP-neutron (gaNN) and ALP-electron (gaee) couplings from 3He-K comagnetometer data over masses ~3e-18 to 4e-13 eV. The y-axis is gaNN in GeV^-1. No numerical table of the exclusion curve is provided in the text; only a bound |b_n| < 5.5e-33 GeV at 95% CL for the constant-field (ma<1.8e-22 eV) case is given, which requires converting through gaNN = b_n/(sqrt(2*rho_a)*v) to obtain a coupling. The emitted data_points are rough placeholders spanning the stated mass range and are NOT reliable numerical values — the exclusion curve is only available graphically in Fig. 3. Density assumption rho_DM=0.4 GeV/cm^3, v=0.77e-3.
